get.summary: Retrieves a single abandoned booking by ID.
get.description:
Returns detailed information about the abandoned booking including customer info,
step where it was abandoned, and associated lead type. Returns NOT_FOUND if not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the abandoned booking to retrieve.

post.summary: Lists abandoned bookings matching specified criteria.
post.description:
Returns a paginated list of abandoned bookings filtered by abandon time,
status, step, or lead type.

post.summary: Gets available dates and times for online booking.
post.description:
Returns available dates and times for online booking based on business hours,
staff availability, and other scheduling constraints. This endpoint helps 
customers find suitable time slots when booking services online.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
Request message for GetBookingAvailability.
Used to query available time slots for online bookings.

AbandonedBookingLeadType.description:
LeadType indicates how the customer was acquired or originated from.

 - LEAD_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. This value is unused.
 - NEW_VISITOR: New visitor to the system.
 - EXISTING_CLIENT: Existing client returning for another service.

AbandonedBookingPreferredFrequencyType.description:
Frequency type of the abandonment process.

 - PREFERRED_FREQUENCY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. This value is unused.
 - PREFERRED_FREQUENCY_TYPE_DAY: Daily
 - PREFERRED_FREQUENCY_TYPE_WEEK: Weekly
 - PREFERRED_FREQUENCY_TYPE_MONTH: Monthly

key.description: Unique identifier for the question-answer pair.

question.description: The question shown to the user.

answer.description: The answer provided by the user.

AbandonedBookingQuestionAnswer.description: QuestionAnswer represents a key-value pair capturing user input during the booking flow.

AbandonedBookingRecoverType.description:
RecoverType indicates how an abandoned booking was recovered.

 - ABANDON_RECOVER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. This value is unused.
 - RECOVERED_BY_SCHEDULE_APPOINTMENT: Booking was recovered by scheduling an appointment.
 - RECOVERED_BY_EMAIL: Booking was recovered through email communication.
 - RECOVERED_BY_MESSAGE: Booking was recovered through messaging (e.g., SMS).

AbandonedBookingStep.description:
Step represents the stage in the booking process where the abandonment occurred.

 - ABANDON_STEP_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. This value is unused.
 - WELCOME_PAGE: Customer visited the welcome page.
 - BASIC_INFO: Customer filled out basic info.
 - SELECT_CARE_TYPE: Customer selected care type.
 - SELECT_ADDRESS: Customer selected address.
 - SELECT_PET: Customer selected pet.
 - SELECT_DATE: Customer selected date.
 - SELECT_SERVICE: Customer selected service.
 - SELECT_GROOMER: Customer selected groomer.
 - SELECT_TIME: Customer selected time.
 - ADDITIONAL_PET_INFO: Customer provided additional pet info.
 - PERSONAL_INFO: Customer entered personal info.
 - CARD_ON_FILE: Customer provided card on file.
 - PREPAY: Customer initiated prepay.
 - PRE_AUTH: Customer initiated pre-auth.
 - SUBMIT_APPT: Customer submitted the appointment.

ServiceItemType.description:
ItemType categorizes the primary type of service being offered.
This helps organize services in the system and determines applicable business rules.

 - SERVICE_ITEM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified service type
Should not be used when creating new services
 - GROOMING: Pet grooming services
Includes bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, etc.
 - BOARDING: Pet boarding services

 - DAYCARE: Daytime pet care services
Supervised play and care during business hours
 - EVALUATION: Pet evaluation services
Behavior assessment and service compatibility check
 - TRAINING: Pet training services
Individual or group training sessions

WeightUnit.description:
Supported weight units. Each unit can be converted to others
using standard conversion factors.

 - UNIT_UNSPECIFIED: Not intended for direct use
 - KILOGRAM: Kilograms, base unit for weight
1 kg = 2.20462 lbs
 - POUND: Pounds, common in US and some other regions
1 lb = 0.453592 kg

year.description:
Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without
a year.

month.description:
Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a
month and day.

day.description:
Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0
to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't
significant.

typeDate.description:
* A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values
* A month and day value, with a zero year, such as an anniversary
* A year on its own, with zero month and day values
* A year and month value, with a zero day, such as a credit card expiration
date

Related types are [google.type.TimeOfDay][google.type.TimeOfDay] and
`google.protobuf.Timestamp`.
typeDate.title:
Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of
day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The
date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the
following:

startTime.description:
Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be the same
or after the start.

endTime.description:
Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be before the
end.

typeInterval.description:
Represents a time interval, encoded as a Timestamp start (inclusive) and a
Timestamp end (exclusive).

The start must be less than or equal to the end.
When the start equals the end, the interval is empty (matches no time).
When both start and end are unspecified, the interval matches any time.

latitude.description: The latitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-90.0, +90.0].

longitude.description: The longitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-180.0, +180.0].

typeLatLng.description: An object that represents a latitude/longitude pair. This is expressed as a pair of doubles to represent degrees latitude and degrees longitude. Unless specified otherwise, this must conform to the WGS84 standard. Values must be within normalized ranges.

currencyCode.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

units.description:
The whole units of the amount.
For example if `currencyCode` is `"USD"`, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

nanos.description:
Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount.
The value must be between -999,999,999 and +999,999,999 inclusive.
If `units` is positive, `nanos` must be positive or zero.
If `units` is zero, `nanos` can be positive, zero, or negative.
If `units` is negative, `nanos` must be negative or zero.
For example $-1.75 is represented as `units`=-1 and `nanos`=-750,000,000.

typeMoney.description: Represents an amount of money with its currency type.

v1AbandonedBooking.description:
AbandonedBooking represents a booking that was not completed by the customer.
This message captures information about the customer, selected services,
abandonment step, and recovery status for analytics and follow-up actions.

v1AbandonedBookingCustomer.description:
AbandonedBookingCustomer contains information about the customer associated with an abandoned booking.
It includes both core customer data and additional booking-specific preferences and metadata.

v1AbandonedBookingPet.description:
AbandonedBookingPet represents a pet involved in an abandoned booking.
It captures service-related details along with emergency contact and health information.

v1AbandonedBookingStatus.description:
Status of the abandonment process.

 - ABANDON_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default value. This value is unused.
 - ABANDONED: The booking was abandoned before completion.
 - CONTACTED: The customer has been contacted regarding this abandoned booking.
 - RECOVERED: The booking was successfully recovered.

v1Address.description:
The address object represents a physical location used throughout the system.
It provides a standardized way to store and validate address information for
businesses, customers, and service locations. The address format follows
common postal standards and includes geocoding information for mapping.

v1AddressType.description:
- TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Not intended for direct use. Indicates a system anomaly.
 - PRIMARY: Primary Address, which will be used as first address choice.
 - SECONDARY: Secondary Address, an optional address saved as back-up
v1AddressType.title:
Possible values are `primary`, `secondary`.
Type represents the importance of the address

v1GetBookingAvailabilityRequest.description:
Request message for GetBookingAvailability.
Used to query available time slots for online bookings.

startDate.description:
Start date for availability check.
Optional. If not provided, defaults to today's date.

endDate.description:
End date for availability check.
Optional. If not provided, defaults to start_date.

serviceIds.description:
Filter by the service IDs.
Optional. When provided, only shows availability for these specific services.

staffIds.description:
Filter by the staff IDs.
Optional. When provided, only shows availability for these specific staff members.

pets.description:
Filter by the pet parameters.
Optional. Specifies pet-related requirements for the booking.

v1GetBookingAvailabilityRequestFilter.description:
Filter parameters for the availability check.
All fields are optional. When not provided, system defaults will be used.

availableDates.description:
List of available dates.
These are dates where at least one time slot is available.

availability.description:
Detailed availability information by date and staff.
Contains comprehensive availability data for all dates with available slots.

v1GetBookingAvailabilityResponse.description:
Response message for GetBookingAvailability.
Contains available dates and detailed time slot information for booking.

pagination.description:
Pagination parameters.
Use page_size to specify results per page (max 500).
Use page_token from previous response for next page.

companyId.description:
The company identifier for multi-location businesses.
Required for company-wide listing.

businessIds.description: List of business location IDs to include.

filter.description: Optional filters to narrow the results.

abandonTime.description:
Filter by the abandon time range of the booking.
By default, it is set to the most recent week. The end and start times cannot exceed one month.

leadTypes.title:
Filter by the lead types of the abandoned booking.
Example values: ["LEAD_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "NEW_VISITOR", "EXISTING_CLIENT"]

steps.title:
Filter by the steps at which the booking was abandoned.
Example values: ["WELCOME_PAGE", "BASIC_INFO", "SELECT_CARE_TYPE", ...]

statuses.title:
Filter by the statuses of the abandoned bookings.
Example values: ["ABANDONED", "CONTACTED", "RECOVERED"]

v1ListAbandonedBookingsRequestFilter.description: Filter parameters for the abandoned booking list.

nextPageToken.description:
Token for retrieving the next page of results.
Empty if there are no more results.

bookings.description: List of abandoned bookings matching the request criteria.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

array(ServiceDetail), List of services scheduled for this pet.

v1PetServiceDetail.description:
The pet service detail object represents the services booked for a specific pet in an appointment.
Each appointment can include multiple pets, and each pet can receive multiple services.
This object links pets with their scheduled services and maintains the service-specific details
such as pricing, duration, and assigned staff.

v1PetStatus.description:
Status indicates whether the pet is currently receiving services.
This affects appointment scheduling and service availability.

 - STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified status
 - ALIVE: Pet is currently receiving services
Default status for new pets
 - PASSED_AWAY: Pet is no longer receiving services
Historical records are maintained

v1PetType.description:
Type defines the species of the pet.
This helps determine appropriate services, care requirements, and pricing.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified pet type
 - OTHER: Pet type not listed in standard categories
Requires special handling and service customization
 - DOG: Canine companion
Common breeds include Labrador, German Shepherd, Golden Retriever
 - CAT: Feline companion
Includes all domestic cat breeds
 - BIRD: Avian pet
Includes parrots, canaries, finches, etc.
 - RABBIT: Domestic rabbit
Requires specific grooming and handling techniques
 - GUINEA_PIG: Guinea pig
Small rodent requiring gentle handling
 - HORSE: Equine
Requires specialized facilities and care
 - HAMSTER: Hamster
Small rodent with specific handling needs
 - RAT: Rat
Intelligent rodent requiring social interaction
 - MOUSE: Mouse
Small rodent needing careful handling
 - CHINCHILLA: Chinchilla
Requires special dust baths and temperature control

Used for staff scheduling and customer notifications.

staffIds.title:
array(string), IDs of staff members assigned to this service.

v1ServiceDetail.description:
The service detail object represents a specific service booked for a pet.
It contains all the information needed to perform the service, including
timing, pricing, staff assignments, and service-specific parameters.

v1ServiceType.description:
Type indicates whether this is a standalone service or an add-on
that can be combined with other services.

 - SERVICE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified type
Should not be used when creating new services
 - SERVICE: Primary standalone service
Can be booked independently
 - ADDON: Additional service that complements primary services
Must be booked with a primary service

v1Weight.description:
The weight object provides a standardized way to represent and convert
weight measurements throughout the system. It supports multiple units
and ensures consistent weight tracking for pets, products, and other
resources that require weight measurements.
